name: Federal default standard age curve — verified subset only
applies_to: Plan years 2018+, states without a state-specific age curve. Tennessee county files in this folder price exactly with these ratios at ages 0-14, 21 and 40 (checked for every listed plan).

verification.0-14: CMS curve (docs/SOURCES.md) and data: Child 0-14 / Adult 21 = 0.765 for every plan in davidson_tn_silver_2026.json and _2027.json
verification.38: CMS curve, recorded in docs/SOURCES.md for the synthetic family
verification.39: CMS curve, recorded in docs/SOURCES.md for the synthetic family
verification.40: CMS curve and data: Adult 40 / Adult 21 = 1.278 for every listed plan

not_included: Every other age. The full curve was not re-read from the primary source in round 5 (cms.gov not reachable from the build session), so other ages are NOT estimated: the resolver asks for the Marketplace benchmark instead.
child_rule: At most the three oldest children under age 21 are charged in a family policy (45 CFR 147.102(c)(1)); applies only to children; not needed for the verified ages above unless a family lists more than three children under 21.
